necessary_context.content: For fixed finite real beta>2, k=ceil(beta)-1, alpha=beta-k in (0,1], p=(beta-1)/beta. F_beta(d) consists of f:R^d->R in C^k, with unique global minimizer x* in the closed Euclidean unit ball, and for every x,y in R^d: f(y)>=f(x)+<grad f(x),y-x>+||y-x||^2/2; ||grad f(x)-grad f(y)||<=3||x-y||; ||D^k f(x)-D^k f(y)||_op<=||x-y||^alpha. The operator norm is sup |A[u1,...,uk]| over independently chosen unit-ball directions.
necessary_context.name: Normalized class and norm

necessary_context.content: One call at any adaptive z in R^d returns f(z)+xi, xi iid N(0,1) independent of algorithm randomness. Arbitrary computation, memory and randomization; output unrestricted. Every scalar value counts, including repeated locations and both members of a pair.
necessary_context.name: Raw-value experiment
